sentences.en: If the nearest location is outside your zip code, use that location's zip for finding coupons.While at the KFC website, join the Colonel's e-mail club in order to receive information about upcoming promotions, coupons and specials.

sentences.en: At times, KFC might offer special coupons as part of a promotion with another company or person, like the Oprah coupon for grilled chicken that was offered to promote the new menu item at KFC restaurants.
